subject: GençBizz (S6B-0026, my proposal) vs. GençBizzTech (live row 5d5a5f4d-3314-48b4-927b-383402161f70, category=entrepreneurship)
verdict: CONFIRMED DISTINCT SIBLING PROGRAMMES, NOT A DUPLICATE. S6B-0026 stands as a genuinely separate new-record proposal.
how_checked: Direct visit to gencbasari.org (the parent foundation's own top-level site) and gencbizztech.org (the live row's own official_url).
evidence_gencbasari_org_top_level: The foundation's own top navigation lists 'GençBizz' and 'GençBizzTech' as two SEPARATE links. The 'Çalışma Alanlarımız' (Our Working Areas) section lists three distinct programmes by name: GENÇBİZZ ('Liseli gençler için içerikler geliştiren bir Genç Başarı Eğitim Vakfı programı' -- a GBEV programme developing content for high school youth generally), JUNİORBİZZ (for younger children), and JA STARTUP TÜRKİYE (for university students). GençBizzTech is referenced separately in the foundation's own news feed, including one item headed 'Fen Lisesi Öğrencilerine Müjde! GençBizz Tech Başv[urusu]' (Good news for Science High School students! GençBizzTech application...) -- signalling a distinct, narrower target audience from GençBizz's general high-school-wide programme.
evidence_gencbizztech_org_own_site: Direct quote from gencbizztech.org's own homepage: 'GençBizzTech, Genç Başarı Eğitim Vakfı ve Türkiye İş Bankası iş birliğiyle devlet fen lisesi öğrencileri...' (GençBizzTech, in cooperation between Genç Başarı Eğitim Vakfı and Türkiye İş Bankası, [is for] state science high school students...) -- explicitly restricts GençBizzTech to 'devlet fen lisesi öğrencileri' (state science-high-school students specifically), a materially narrower population than GençBizz's 'all secondary schools across Türkiye's 81 provinces under the Ministry of National Education protocol' (my original S6B-0026 finding).
distinguishing_facts: Different domain: gencbasari.org/gencbizz/ (GençBizz) vs. gencbizztech.org (GençBizzTech), a dedicated separate site.
Different sponsor structure: GençBizz is a GBEV programme under a Ministry of National Education protocol; GençBizzTech is explicitly co-run with Türkiye İş Bankası as a named partner.
Different eligible population: GençBizz is open to any Turkish secondary school; GençBizzTech is restricted to state science high schools (Fen Lisesi) specifically.

Different focus: GençBizz is general small-business/entrepreneurship ('kurdukları GençBizz Şirketi'); GençBizzTech is explicitly 'bilim ve teknoloji tabanlı' (science-and-technology-based), and its 2026 winning projects were concrete tech/science prototypes -- LABORATUV-AR (an AR/VR lab-education platform), VIRTUAL BIOPSY (AI-assisted skin-lesion analysis, built by Konya Meram Fen Lisesi students), and AGROGEN (agricultural technology).

Different 2026 winning teams, confirming separate competition cycles, not the same event double-counted: GençBizz's 2026 Türkiye Finali winner was 'Quareka GençBizz Şirketi' (per my original research); GençBizzTech's 2026 Türkiye Finali winner was 'LABORATUV-AR' (confirmed directly on gencbizztech.org this pass).
shared_feature_explained: Both programmes culminate in a Turkey Final whose winner earns a place at GEN-E (Europe's major student-entrepreneurship festival, Latvia 2026) -- this shared endpoint is what created the risk of conflation, but it is explained by both being sibling GBEV/JA Türkiye programmes feeding into the same larger JA Europe festival structure, not evidence they are the same competition.
action_taken: S6B-0026 (my GençBizz record) stands as-is, a genuine new-record proposal, NOT converted to an enrichment of the live GençBizzTech row. Recommend the live GençBizzTech row (5d5a5f4d) be cross-referenced as a related-but-separate sibling in any future consolidated view, so nobody merges the two records later on the strength of the shared foundation name and shared GEN-E endpoint alone.
